home_title.en: Video Player and YouTube Player in JS | pardnchiu/FlexPlyr
home_title.zh: 影片播放器、YouTube 播放器與 Vimeo｜pardnchiu/FlexPlyr

en.home: FlexPlyr is a JavaScript video player library by Pardn Chiu (邱敬幃): one API drives HTML5 video and audio, the YouTube player, and Vimeo, with themed panels.
en.getting-started: Load FlexPlyr from jsDelivr or npm, mount a player on an element ID, and wait for the ready callback before calling player methods.
en.architecture: How FlexPlyr is layered: load-time head injection, the FPlyr core, per-source adapters, the playerPanel control bar, and when callbacks.
en.media-sources: Choose between video, audio, youtube, and vimeo sources in FlexPlyr, the priority order when several are set, and waiting for the YouTube and Vimeo SDKs.
en.lifecycle-events: FlexPlyr when callbacks — ready, playing, pause, end, destroyed — when each fires, per-source triggers, and why ready runs before state is set.
en.mobile-fullscreen: How FlexPlyr handles fullscreen: desktop requestFullscreen on the container, and a hidden second player on iOS and Android that syncs time, volume, and speed.
en.panel-themes: The five FlexPlyr panel themes — default, minimal, classic, retro, simple — set with option.panelType and applied through the data-type attribute.
en.panel-controls: Every FlexPlyr panelItem control — play, progress, time, timeMini, volume, volumeMini, rate, full — with ordering rules and the showThumb option.
en.configuration: Full FlexPlyr constructor config: id, source fields, option defaults, when callbacks, detached containers, and how initial volume and mute are applied.
en.instance-api: FlexPlyr instance methods and properties: play, pause, isPaused, isMuted, destroy, body, option, panel, stateFull, plus globals and ESM exports.
en.runtime-dependencies: The stylesheet, Material Symbols font, and YouTube and Vimeo SDK scripts FlexPlyr injects into the page head on load, and what that means for CSP and SSR.
en.deprecations: FlexPlyr options and globals scheduled for removal in 3.x — type, panel, volume, mute, event, PDPlayer, player — with their replacements.

zh.home: FlexPlyr 是邱敬幃（Pardn Chiu）開發的 JavaScript 影片播放器套件，以單一 API 驅動 HTML5 影音、YouTube 播放器與 Vimeo，附主題控制列。
zh.getting-started: 從 jsDelivr 或 npm 載入 FlexPlyr，以元素 ID 掛載播放器，並在 ready 回呼之後再呼叫播放器方法。
zh.architecture: FlexPlyr 的分層：載入時注入 head 資源、FPlyr 核心、各來源轉接、playerPanel 控制列與 when 回呼。
zh.media-sources: FlexPlyr 的 video、audio、youtube、vimeo 四種來源、優先順序，以及等待 YouTube／Vimeo SDK 的方式。
zh.lifecycle-events: FlexPlyr 的 when 回呼 ready、playing、pause、end、destroyed 觸發時機，以及 ready 早於狀態設定的原因。
zh.mobile-fullscreen: FlexPlyr 的全螢幕處理：桌面版對容器呼叫 requestFullscreen，行動裝置以隱藏的第二個播放器同步進度、音量與倍速。
zh.panel-themes: FlexPlyr 五種面板風格：預設、minimal、classic、retro、simple，以 option.panelType 設定。
zh.panel-controls: FlexPlyr 八種 panelItem 控制元件（play、progress、time、volume、rate、full 等）、排序與 showThumb。
zh.configuration: FlexPlyr 建構子完整設定：id、來源欄位、option 預設值、when 回呼、獨立容器，以及初始 volume 與 mute 的套用方式。
zh.instance-api: FlexPlyr 實例方法 play、pause、isPaused、isMuted、destroy，屬性 body、option、panel，與全域匯出。
zh.runtime-dependencies: FlexPlyr 載入時注入 head 的樣式表、圖示字型與 YouTube／Vimeo SDK，及其對 CSP 與 SSR 的影響。
zh.deprecations: FlexPlyr 預計於 3.x 移除的設定與全域名稱（type、panel、event、PDPlayer 等）及替代寫法。
